# canada.worldplaces.me

> > A comprehensive Canadian business directory and review platform featuring interactive maps, local business listings, and community feedback across major cities.

WorldPlaces Canada provides an aggregated directory of places, businesses, and services across Canada with user-generated reviews and ratings. The platform offers interactive mapping, city-specific directories, and community feedback for thousands of Canadian locations.

## Key Topics

- Canada
- Interactive Maps
- Local Businesses
- User Reviews
- Business Ratings
- City Directories
- Place Listings
- Community Feedback
- Vancouver
- Montreal
- Calgary
- Ottawa
- Edmonton
- Place Mapping
- Business Reviews

## Core Platform

- [Places on Canada map, Reviews and Complaints - WorldPlaces](https://canada.worldplaces.me): WorldPlaces homepage: Canada map with reviews and business listings
- [Map of Places and Companies - WorldPlaces](https://canada.worldplaces.me/maps/places.html): Interactive map of places and companies across Canada
- [Canada latest reviews and complaints - WorldPlaces](https://canada.worldplaces.me/browse-reviews.html): Browse latest reviews and complaints for Canadian businesses
